required_evidence: Fresh detached source worktrees on the same physical host; no parent build graph.
Inspect both method bodies, pre-copy and copied branches, mutation ownership, concrete producers and consumers, relevant history, documentation, and bounded existing upstream/fork work.
Prefer resolved C# LSP references; disclose unavailable or incomplete inventories rather than inferring exhaustive absence from lexical matches.
Exercise an unchanged real MVC producer and its externally observable membership/copy contract where practical on both pins; label helper-only diagnostics separately.

Characterize a proposed equality-comparer substitution against object.Equals, including IEquatable<T> and reference/interface type distinctions, without silently treating unequal contracts as equivalent.
Run the smallest relevant existing project tests when practical; preserve exact commands, streams, assertions, per-case outcomes, and all failed preparation attempts.
Associate executed physical source, owner PE and PDB, source pin, requested runtime, and installed runtime explicitly.
Produce reproducible scripts/projects and a concise JSON disposition/handoff; record source status and terminal owned process state.

optimization_requires: A material shipping producer that reaches the claimed value-type boxing condition.
Equality and copy-on-write semantics preserved at the actual consumer boundary.
A minimal artifact-only patch and bounded runnable benchmark preparation, with a pre-timing primary and gain gate, only if an optimization remains justified.
candidate_gate.otherwise: Recommend rejection or deferral with precise evidence and reachability/extension limitations; do not describe an untimed result as measured no-gain.

excluded: Benchmarks, intentional timings, allocation counters, performance verdicts, historical replay, tuning, and budget reopening.
Shipping edits, commits, publication, GitHub writes, remote nodes/jobs, shared campaign/policy/lease/budget/ledger writes.
Machine-wide installation or machine, power, priority, affinity, firewall, certificate, or credential changes.
Broader generic collection cleanup and claims that arbitrary helper instantiations establish shipping reachability.
